_: Observed prices, one row per thing he could put in a basket. NEVER a guess: every row carries where it was read, when, and from WHICH surface, because on 2026-08-18 two Walmart search tiles disagreed with their own product pages by $4.66 and $10.28 and both were load-bearing protein lines. `readFrom` is the honesty field: `product-page` was opened and read, `tile` came off a search result and has been wrong before. Anything older than 14 days renders as stale rather than as fact, per PRICE_STALE_DAYS in src/lib/kitchen/list.ts.
_rule: A price comes from a receipt or a live lookup or it does not appear. Standing rule since 2026-08-02, when guessed pasta prices produced a confidently wrong buy recommendation.
